theorem: The F2 line-point incidence 2-rank of W(3,q) is (q^2+1)(q+2)/2 for odd q; the dual/sentinel dimension is q(q^2+1)/2 = (n-k)/2 and the CSS logical count is k = q^2+1. Verified exactly at q = 3,5,7 (25,91,225) and freshly at q = 11 (793). Even q follows the same formula minus a characteristic-2 correction 0,1,27 at q = 2,4,8 (true ranks 10,50,298).
reading: The previously-open odd-q incidence rank is a single quadratic-in-q closed form (q^2+1)(q+2)/2, freshly confirmed at q=11. The sentinel is exactly half the redundancy (n-k)/2 = q(q^2+1)/2, and k = q^2+1 is forced. Characteristic 2 subtracts a small correction (0,1,27), the fingerprint of the degenerate form.
